# SkyLink Air: Riverton to Lakeport

SkyLink Air operates frequent nonstop service between Riverton Municipal Airport and Lakeport International. The route is popular with business travellers, and our schedule is designed so that you can make a morning meeting and be home the same evening.

## Schedule

Flights depart Riverton throughout the day, with the busiest departures in the early morning and late afternoon. Return flights from Lakeport follow a similar pattern, giving travellers flexibility to adjust plans if meetings run long.

FACT: SkyLink flight takes 70 minutes gate to gate between Riverton and Lakeport.
FACT: SkyLink operates 9 daily flights on the Riverton to Lakeport route.
FACT: SkyLink economy fares on this route start at 145 dollars one way.

## Fare types

Economy Saver fares are the lowest price but do not allow changes. Economy Flex fares allow unlimited free changes up to two hours before departure and include a checked bag. Business fares add priority boarding, lounge access and a larger seat.

## Airport tips

Riverton Municipal is a small airport, and security queues are typically short outside of public holidays. Lakeport International is larger, and the airport rail link takes about twenty five minutes to reach the downtown business district. Travellers should allow enough time for this connection when planning meetings.

## Corporate programme

Companies that book more than fifty trips a year can join the SkyLink corporate programme. Benefits include negotiated discounts, flexible name changes and consolidated monthly invoicing. Members also earn points that can be redeemed for upgrades or free flights for future business travel.

Baggage allowances, seat selection fees and onboard refreshment details are listed in the fare conditions shown during booking.
